  /* =========================================
   HYDRAFACIAL CONTENT
   Scoped with hydrafacial- prefix
========================================= */

.hydrafacial-content {
    background: #f8f6f2;
    color: #4c4641;
    padding: 85px 0 100px;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.hydrafacial-container {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
    margin: 0 auto;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   COMMON
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-section {
    margin-top: 85px;
}

.hydrafacial-label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    color: #97702b;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hydrafacial-section h2,
.hydrafacial-final h2 {
    margin: 0 0 28px;
    color: #342820;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 52px);
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.15;
}

.hydrafacial-content p {
    margin: 0 0 22px;
    color: #625b55;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.85;
}

.hydrafacial-content a {
    color: #8d6828;
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(141, 104, 40, 0.35);
    transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.hydrafacial-content a:hover {
    color: #b48635;
    border-color: #b48635;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   INTRO
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-intro {
    max-width: 1050px;
}

.hydrafacial-intro p {
    color: #4c4641;
    font-size: 21px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   BENEFITS
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-benefits {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin: 40px 0 30px;
}

.hydrafacial-benefit-card {
    padding: 30px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e8e0d6;
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.hydrafacial-benefit-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(57, 43, 32, 0.08);
}

.hydrafacial-benefit-card span {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 20px;
}

.hydrafacial-benefit-card p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   CONCERNS
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-concerns {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 15px;
    margin: 35px 0;
}

.hydrafacial-concern {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 15px;
    padding: 25px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e5ddd4;
}

.hydrafacial-concern span {
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 18px;
}

.hydrafacial-concern p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   PROCEDURE
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-procedure {
    margin-top: 40px;
}

.hydrafacial-step {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr;
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 30px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #ded5ca;
}

.hydrafacial-step:last-child {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ded5ca;
}

.hydrafacial-step-number {
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 24px;
}

.hydrafacial-step h3 {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    color: #382d26;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.hydrafacial-step p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   WHY CHOOSE
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-why {
    margin: 40px 0 30px;
    border-top: 1px solid #ded5ca;
}

.hydrafacial-why-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr;
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 25px 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ded5ca;
}

.hydrafacial-why-item span {
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 22px;
}

.hydrafacial-why-item p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   AFTERCARE
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-aftercare {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 15px;
    margin: 35px 0 30px;
}

.hydrafacial-aftercare-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 18px;
    padding: 22px 25px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e5ddd4;
}

.hydrafacial-aftercare-item span {
    color: #a0782d;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 18px;
}

.hydrafacial-aftercare-item p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 15px;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   FINAL
----------------------------------------- */

.hydrafacial-final {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 90px;
    padding: 65px;
    text-align: center;
    background: #342820;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

.hydrafacial-final::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 330px;
    height: 330px;
    right: -140px;
    top: -140px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196, 153, 71, 0.25);
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.hydrafacial-final::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 230px;
    height: 230px;
    left: -120px;
    bottom: -120px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(196, 153, 71, 0.18);
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.hydrafacial-final .hydrafacial-label {
    color: #c99c4a;
}

.hydrafacial-final h2 {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    color: #fff;
}

.hydrafacial-final p {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    max-width: 900px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    color: #d9d1c8;
}

.hydrafacial-final a {
    color: #d5ad61;
}


/* -----------------------------------------
   TABLET
----------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

    .hydrafacial-content {
        padding: 65px 0 80px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-benefits {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .hydrafacial-concerns {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

    .hydrafacial-aftercare {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

}


/* -----------------------------------------
   MOBILE
----------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 600px) {

    .hydrafacial-container {
        width: min(100% - 30px, 1180px);
    }

    .hydrafacial-content {
        padding: 50px 0 60px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-section {
        margin-top: 60px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-label {
        margin-bottom: 14px;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: 3px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-section h2,
    .hydrafacial-final h2 {
        font-size: 32px;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .hydrafacial-content p {
        font-size: 15px;
        line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .hydrafacial-intro p {
        font-size: 18px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-benefit-card {
        padding: 25px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-concerns {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .hydrafacial-step {
        grid-template-columns: 45px 1fr;
        gap: 15px;
        padding: 28px 0;
    }

    .hydrafacial-step h3 {
        font-size: 21px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-why-item {
        grid-template-columns: 45px 1fr;
        gap: 15px;
    }

    .hydrafacial-final {
        margin-top: 60px;
        padding: 40px 22px;
    }

}
</style>

contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Hydra-Facial in Ghaziabad & Noida

Instant Glow, Deep Hydration, Lasting Radiance

At Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic, we offer advanced Hydrafacial treatment in Noida designed to deeply cleanse, hydrate, and rejuvenate your skin. If you are looking for a safe, non-invasive solution to achieve radiant and healthy skin, Hydrafacial is one of the most effective modern skincare treatments available.

HYDRAFACIAL

What is Hydrafacial?

Hydrafacial is a medical-grade facial treatment that combines cleansing, exfoliation, extraction, hydration, and antioxidant protection in one procedure. It uses a specialized device to remove dead skin cells and impurities while simultaneously infusing nourishing serums into the skin. This multi-step approach makes it suitable for all skin types and addresses a wide range of skin concerns without discomfort or downtime.

KEY BENEFITS

Benefits of Hydrafacial Treatment

Hydrafacial is highly popular due to its immediate and visible results. Some key benefits include:

01

Deep cleansing and exfoliation of the skin

02

Reduction in acne, blackheads, and clogged pores

03

Improved skin texture and tone

04

Hydration and nourishment for dry skin

05

Reduction in fine lines and early signs of aging

06

Brighter, smoother, and glowing complexion

The treatment is gentle yet effective, making it ideal for both men and women who want healthy, refreshed skin.

SUITABILITY

Who Can Benefit from Hydrafacial?

Hydrafacial treatment is suitable for individuals dealing with:

01

Acne and oily skin

02

Pigmentation and uneven skin tone

03

Dull or dehydrated skin

04

Enlarged pores

05

Fine lines and wrinkles

At Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic , our specialists carefully assess your skin and customize the treatment to deliver optimal results based on your skin type and concerns.

THE PROCEDURE

Procedure of Hydrafacial

The Hydrafacial procedure typically involves the following steps:

01

Cleansing & Exfoliation

Removal of dead skin cells and surface impurities

02

Acid Peel

Gentle peel to loosen dirt and debris from pores

03

Extraction

Painless suction to clear clogged pores

04

Hydration

Infusion of hydrating serums rich in antioxidants and peptides

05

Protection

Application of moisturizers and sunscreen

The entire procedure usually takes about 30–45 minutes and requires no downtime, allowing you to resume your daily activities immediately.

TREATMENT COST

Hydrafacial Cost in Noida

The cost of Hydrafacial treatment in Noida generally ranges between ₹2,000 and ₹8,000 per session, depending on the type of facial, customization, and clinic expertise. At Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic, we offer personalized treatment plans to ensure you receive the best value and visible results.

WHY REVIVA

Why Choose Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

Choosing the right clinic is essential for safe and effective results. At Reviva, you benefit from:

01

Experienced dermatologists and skin specialists

02

Advanced skincare technology

03

Personalized treatment approach

04

Hygienic and comfortable environment

05

Focus on long-lasting skin health

Our clinic is committed to delivering high-quality dermatological and cosmetic treatments tailored to individual needs.

AFTERCARE

Aftercare Tips

To maintain your results after Hydrafacial:

01

Use gentle skincare products

02

Apply sunscreen daily

03

Stay hydrated

04

Avoid harsh exfoliation for a few days

Following proper aftercare enhances the longevity of your glowing skin.

BOOK YOUR TREATMENT

Book Your Hydrafacial Today

If you are searching for the best Hydrafacial treatment in Noida, visit Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic for expert care and visible results. Our team ensures a safe, comfortable, and effective skincare experience tailored just for you. Achieve radiant, refreshed, and youthful skin with professional Hydrafacial treatment, because your skin deserves the best care.
